The signal vectors s1 and s2 are used to represent 
binary symbols 1 and 0, respectively in a coherent 
binary FSK system. The receiver decides in favour of 
symbol 1 when 
 
[X]T s1 > [X]T s2 
 
Where [X]T s1 is the inner product of the observation 
vector [X] and signal vector s1, where i = 1, 2, …. If 
x1 and x2 are the elements of the observation vector 
[X] and the signal vector s1 and s2 have equal energy, 
then the given decision rule is equivalent to the 
condition 
 
(a) 
x1 > x 
 
 
 
(b) 
x1 < x2 
 
(c) 
x1 = x2   
 
(d) 
Can’t be determined
